summary: JinkoSolar filed a Form 6-K announcing the sale of a 75.1% equity interest in its U.S. subsidiary, Jinko Solar (U.S.) Industries Inc., to FH JKV Holdings Limited for approximately US$191.5 million. Consideration will be paid in three tranches: 51% at closing, 15.71% second, and 33.29% third. The disposal is supported by the board and aligns with the company's strategic restructuring to improve operational efficiency. Post-closing, JinkoSolar retains a 24.9% interest; the subsidiary will cease to be consolidated. The valuation was based on an independent appraisal as of November 30, 2025. Completion is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance and any adjustment to the purchase price based on net asset value.
